newsitem.title: USA: US Rentals same-store sales growth to slow.
newsitem.headline: US Rentals same-store sales growth to slow.

text.p: U.S. Rentals Inc said it could add about 15 new locations in the second half of 1997, but does not expect the rate of growth in same store sales to maintain the torrid pace of the first half.
It expects to see second half, same store sales grow at a more normal rate of between 15 percent and 18 percent.

Its forecast was based largely on the fact the second half last year was much stronger than the first half which preceded it. U.S. Rentals also said it purchased the assets of Alabama Contractors Equipment Rental, a 38-year-old company with two locations in Montgomery, and single locations in Gadsden, Albertville, Anniston, and Trussville in an all-cash deal.
